Prong 1: Prevention of HIV among women of reproductive age within services related to reproductive health, such as antenatal care, post-partum and post-natal care and other health and HIV service delivery points, including working with community structures.
Prong 2: Providing appropriate counselling and support, and contraceptives, to women living with HIV, to meet their unmet needs for family planning and spacing of births, and to optimize health outcomes for these women and their children.
Prong 3: For pregnant women living with HIV, ensuring HIV testing and counselling, and access to the antiretroviral (ARV) drugs needed to prevent HIV infection from being passed on to their babies during pregnancy, delivery and breastfeeding.
Prong 4: HIV care, treatment and support for women and children living with HIV, and for their families.
